title: Left 4 Dead 2 and Titanfall 2 Have Been COMPLETELY MERGED
author: ImolaBoost

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
...so, what about this is either Left4Dead or Titanfall 2 ? 

like, do you honestly think that a game is just the models and franchise branding that goes into it? that's what games are in your mind, so if you put Mario into Batman: Arkham Asylum, now those games are 'merged' and the game is both games?

replies.author: ImolaBoost
replies.body: Are you stupid? This is literally both games running simultaneously with an engine translation layer between them.

replies.author: Zealousideal-Bug1837
replies.body: big f'in woop. still a shit "game"

replies.author: ImolaBoost
replies.body: It's a mod I threw together in 2 days to do some fun swingies and wall runs in L4D (and continue the momentum on my YT channel that's absolutely exploding), so, get over it?

comments.author: TehGuard
comments.body: My main gripe and maybe I missed it but left 4 dead despite the numerous guns relies alot on the melee in the game. Without it the game looks pretty hollow

replies.author: attackpotato
replies.body: L4D also relies on the corridor shooting, the need to stick together, the limited mobility of the survivors relative to the abilities of the special zombies - in short, everything that made L4D work is completely absent from this. The complete merge makes no mention of the 4 player coop, or the team-based vs. gameplay that turned L4D into an absolute classic. It's like combining ice cream and pulled pork - novel, but pointless.

replies.author: ImolaBoost
replies.body: It's a mod I threw together in 2 days to have fun swinging around the L4D2 campaigns. I'm not exactly trying to create Elden Ring here.

replies.author: ImolaBoost
replies.body:
Yeah.

Did I want to spend the extra day integrating them? No.

replies.body:
***CLICKBAIT***

Given I've grown a YouTube channel to nearly 1k subs and 300k views in a week, I like my methodology.
